severity_scale.P0: scientific correctness or severe system-integrity failure

defects.title: 1-D potentials return a 1-D array on a 3-D grid, applied along z
defects.evidence: independently reproduced: CrystalPotential.evaluate(Grid3D(16,16,16)).shape == (16,); broadcast-axis probe shows a (N,) array varies along the LAST axis (z); Grid3D(16,16,8) raises ValueError
defects.invariant_expected: potential array shape must equal grid.shape; spatial orientation must match the declared axis

defects.title: vortex winding detector reports zero winding for a state with unit winding
defects.evidence: psi=(x+iy)exp(-r^2/2), core at origin on a grid node: plaquette sum = -0.0000 (q=0) vs independent contour integral +6.2823 (q=+0.9999); vortex_positions returns 0 vortices. Shifted off-node by (0.13,0.07): both agree, 1 vortex found.
defects.invariant_expected: sum of plaquette charges must match the winding measured by an independent contour integral
defects.regression_coverage: partial — tests/test_new_potentials_and_observables.py:127 passes because its configuration avoids the branch-cut placement

defects.title: legacy solvers freeze a time-dependent potential at t=0
defects.evidence: evaluate(grid)=0.0 while evaluate_at(grid,0.05)=2.99; legacy solver vs SplitOperatorSolver diverge by 4.1e-3 over 50 steps
defects.invariant_expected: a time-dependent potential must be evaluated at the current time
defects.authorship_detail: split_step_2d.py / split_step_3d.py user-authored (8c54f3f, b59a20e); split_step_1d.py and time_dependent.py upstream

defects.title: quantumlab.config is dead code and cannot drive SimulationRunner
defects.consumer: none — no importer anywhere in the repo; runner.py never calls load_config
defects.evidence: no importer found by repo-wide grep; SimulationRunner(load_config() output) fails: 'No simulations defined'; nested under simulations fails: missing ['dimension','dt','num_steps']; _build_grid requires grid['L'] (absent); runner.py:148 expects absorbing_boundary as dict (actual: bool False)
defects.invariant_expected: a configuration module's output must be consumable by the runner it appears to configure

defects.title: default min_density suppresses genuine vortex cores
defects.evidence: 2x2 lattice cores at (+-4,+-4): 4 vortices at min_density<=0.05, 0 at the 0.2 default; core-plaquette rho/rho.max = 0.180-0.185
defects.invariant_expected: the default call must detect the vortices the function exists to find

defects.title: unavailable GPU measurements were recorded as zero
GPU docstring claimed bit-identical CPU/GPU evolution
testbench_interlock.py hardcoded a machine-specific sys.path
defects.evidence: inserted path resolved to a non-existent directory; import only worked because quantumlab was installed
defects.residual_gap: still NOT imported by any test — no automated regression gate

defects.title: ABL accepted boundary_width=0 (NaN mask) and negative widths (all-zero mask)
README 3D-example runtime claim contradicted by the example's own docstring
defects.evidence: 'a few minutes on a laptop' vs '~30-40 minutes on a CPU'
